notes: Coverage: the whole image was opened once for layout, then half_a once and half_b once in that order. Every text block, every agreed word and every inline/display formula was compared visually against both C and H. Salutation, all prose, accents, punctuation, both course ordinals, all mathematical arguments, decorations, relations, indices, signs, brackets and all three triangle arrows were included. This is a coverage statement, not a mathematical proof check.

Exactly nineteen tight crops were made after listing the unresolved half-image loci. Each was viewed once. No whole image or half was reopened, no decided locus was recropped, and no OCR, recognition, PDF text layer, external research, other scan or another reader’s return was used. Crop evidence was generated only from the assigned whole image using PIL image processing.

start_utc is the first measured clock time in this run, after input-text reading and before the first image view. The exact opening times of the whole, halves and each crop are recorded. Model identity follows the exposed session identity; model effort is not exposed.

The page is wholly handwritten, so no generic handwritten wrappers are added. Personal authorship of the pen layer is not independently established by this packet. The marginal note has similar forms but is conservatively attributed to an unnamed hand; the archive 8 is a separate lighter pencil-like layer.

The letter says a leg may prevent the proposed first-cycle, first-trimester course, considers an algebra seminar on Mme Sinh’s material in the context of champs, and calls the subsequent idea heuristic. It introduces E(M,N), lists a two-row cohomology condition, and says there should be a canonical distinguished triangle. These are statements reported from the page, not endorsed or proved mathematical conclusions.

The visible first comparison in the invariant condition is read = rather than silently repaired to ≤. The following relation is clearly ≤. The j-like second degree was not changed to match the dotted i in the condition. These source irregularities were not used as evidence against the ink.

No source address, closing, signature, personal manuscript page number, letterhead, page total, or independent non-diagram drawing is visible on this sheet. The sole archive numeral is 8 and is retained as a comment. Edge/seam traces and the long near-bottom sheet-boundary trace are not treated as text or independent drawings.

The top-left marginal line is physically clipped across its upper bodies. Its words remain uncertain even where a plausible phrase can be reconstructed. Its clear second line reads que tu cites. There is no caret identifying a textual insertion attachment.

The dateline clearly contains 7.8.74. The low preceding trace does not by itself securely establish an initial 2; H’s claims about another copy or a later verifier were not imported as evidence from this scan. Lodève and le remain pale readings.

The two isolated compact points near mathematical text are explicitly recorded as having uncertain textual status. One lies above the corrected operator, distinct from the live i dot; one lies between 2 and the closing shift bracket. The phantom alternatives do not deny their physical presence. No extra semantic operation or complete old exponent is inferred.

The cancelled operator and live Ext are separately preserved. The live replacement is inventoried as an insertion/overwriting at the old operator, not as a new word at a caret. The dense first H degree is not claimed to contain a separate cancelled layer.

No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, computation or formal certificate was performed. math_checks is therefore empty. The possible mismatches of degrees and range relations prompted visual attention only.
